title: AI chat
intro: Ask about my projects, writing, photography or this website. Replies come from DeepSeek Flash, using public content from this site. You are talking to an AI, not me.
policy: Five messages per IP per day, with a shared limit of 50 public messages per day. Limits reset at midnight Beijing time. Shared networks share an allowance. Accepted messages count even if a reply is interrupted.
banPolicy: This feature permanently bans IPs that send malformed AI requests or use curl/Python user agents. Bans can be removed by the site owner.
pending: Chat is being configured. Please come back soon.
banned: This IP is banned from Daily AI. Contact the site owner if you need the ban reviewed.
limit: This IP has used its five messages today. You can still read your conversation.
trafficLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a minute before trying again.
fullSite: Open the full site to chat
generationFailed: The reply could not be completed. Accepted messages may still count toward your allowance.
thinkingNotice: Generated by DeepSeek and shown as received. This may contain mistakes and does not verify the answer.
globalLimit: The shared limit of 50 public messages has been reached today. New messages resume at midnight Beijing time.
durationNote: Elapsed time for the provider request, including the time to its first token.
speedNote: Observed streaming throughput using the provider’s token count, including thinking and network time.
tokensNote: Actual completion tokens reported by DeepSeek, including thinking.
outputTruncated: The answer reached its output limit and may be incomplete.
errorEmptyAnswer: The model finished without an answer. Try turning thinking off.
errorStreamIncomplete: The reply was interrupted. Refresh to check your saved conversation.
errorOutputLimit: The model reached its output limit. Try a shorter question or turn thinking off.
errorGenerationTimeout: The reply took too long and was stopped.
errorCancelled: The site controls cancelled this reply.
privacyNotice: Your messages and recent conversation are sent to DeepSeek. Don’t include private or sensitive information. Chats are stored on Cloudflare until the next Beijing midnight.
unlimited: Whitelisted IP · no daily message limit
placeholder: Ask something about Leo or this site…
chatBusy: A reply is already running, or chat is busy. Please wait and try again.
errorProviderAuth: The AI provider could not authenticate this site. Please contact the site owner.
errorProviderBusy: The AI provider is busy. Please try again later.
errorProvider: The AI provider could not complete this reply. Please try again later.
errorProviderBalance: The site’s AI provider balance is insufficient. Please contact the site owner.
